title: Proje headless acilir, import hatasi yok
verify: command -v godot >/dev/null || exit 2; godot --headless --path . --quit-after 2 2>&1 | grep -q -E 'ERROR:|SCRIPT ERROR' && exit 1 || exit 0

title: Tum GDScript dosyalari parse edilir
verify: command -v godot >/dev/null || exit 2; godot --headless --path . --check-only --script-only 2>&1 | grep -q -E 'Parse Error|SCRIPT ERROR' && exit 1 || exit 0

title: Gorev zinciri 3 asamayi sirayla ilerletir, atlanamaz
Yelbegen: can 0 olunca olum sinyali bir kez yayilir
Asset import: eksik bagimlilik veya kayip .import yok
verify: command -v godot >/dev/null || exit 2; godot --headless --path . --import 2>&1 | grep -q -E 'Failed to load|missing dependencies' && exit 1 || exit 0

title: Windows export preset hatasiz build uretir
verify: command -v godot >/dev/null || exit 2; godot --headless --path . --export-release "Windows Desktop" build/kutun-arinisi.exe && test -f build/kutun-arinisi.exe
